definitions.collection_scope: Ethereum Art Blocks contract 0xa7d8d9ef8d8ce8992df33d8b8cf4aebabd5bd270, restricted to project 78 (tokenId / 1000000 = 78), OpenSea slug fidenza-by-tyler-hobbs; wrappers and all other Art Blocks projects are excluded.
definitions.ordering_rounding: Fills are ordered by block timestamp, block number, transaction index, and log index. Durations are integer seconds, arithmetic is exact integer arithmetic, and only the final division by 86400 is floored.

definitions.seed: The latest qualifying fill found before start and within seven days is used as P(start); no future fill is backfilled.
definitions.price: The unit price is the complete resolved ETH/WETH consideration attributable to that isolated order, including seller proceeds, royalties and protocol fees, in wei; WETH is valued 1:1 with ETH.
definitions.floorContext: OpenSea v2 collection-events and collection-stats access returned HTTP 401 without an API key in this environment, so no current listing floor is asserted. It is not used in the TWAP.
definitions.timeWeighting: P(t) is the latest qualifying price at or before t, ordered by block timestamp, block number, transaction index and log index; it is carried forward. The integral uses [start,end), exactly 86400 seconds, and only the final quotient is floored.
definitions.qualifyingSale: Successful Seaport OrderFulfilled settlement whose isolated offer is the collection token, with ETH or WETH consideration only; zero-payment, transfers, mints, non-ETH/WETH currency and unallocated bundles are excluded.
definitions.collectionScope: Ethereum ERC721 contract 0xa7d8d9ef8d8ce8992df33d8b8cf4aebabd5bd270 only; each included Seaport offer contains exactly one unit of this contract and no bundle allocation was used.
